title: Trey McBride: I don't know about Week 1, but Carson Beck has a chance to be a guy

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Trey McBride: I don't know about Week 1, but Carson Beck has a chance to be a guy
sources.description: Cardinals tight end Trey McBride is signed through the 2029 season, so he has good reason to be interested in who will be doing the quarterbacking in Arizona over the coming years.
